answer_3.quote: To conduct LLM evaluation, we ask GPT-4 to identify whether each annotation from Synth-SBDH is correct or not.
methods: LLM evaluation prompt asking GPT-4 to label each annotation as correct or incorrect

answer_4.quote: The same group of two human experts who provided seed examples ... assessed all test annotations and the quality of the provided rationales. Experts considered each GPT-4 generated annotation for one of these actions -keep it when the annotation is correct, update it when there is an error, or discard it if the annotation was unnecessary or erroneous. Additionally, the experts rated the GPT-4-generated rationales on a 4-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Experts used keep/update/discard/add actions for each annotation and rated rationales on a 4-point Likert scale.
